Description: Unique identifier assigned to each participant (original session labels remapped to integers 1-360).
Presentation order of the trial within the session. Article and paragraph order is fixed within a batch and list.
Identifier of the Guardian article the paragraph belongs to.
Identifier of the paragraph within its article.
Text version presented: Adv for the original Guardian paragraph, Ele for the simplified version.
Binary indicator of whether this trial is a second reading of a previously presented article.
Position of the word within the paragraph (1-based; from the DataViewer interest-area index).
The word as displayed on screen for this interest area.
Total reading time on the word in milliseconds (dwell time summed over all fixations). 0 means the word was never fixated.
Duration of the first fixation on the word in milliseconds. Empty if the word was never fixated.
Sum of fixations on the word during the first run through it, in milliseconds. Empty if the word was never fixated.
Time from first entering the word until moving past it to the right, including regressions, in milliseconds. Empty if the word was never fixated.
Number of fixations landing on the word.
Number of separate runs of fixations on the word.
Binary indicator of whether the word received any fixation (1) or none at all (0).
Binary indicator of whether the word was skipped during first-pass reading. A first-pass skipped word may still be fixated later during a regression.
Binary indicator of whether a regression entered this word.
Binary indicator of whether a regression left this word.
The multiple-choice reading comprehension question asked about this paragraph.

The four answer options for this trial, in the order they appeared on screen, separated by ' | '. Answer position was randomised per trial. Recorded once per trial, on the row where word_position is 1.
On-screen position (1-4) of the correct answer for this trial.
On-screen position (1-4) of the answer the participant selected.
Binary indicator of whether the participant's response was correct.
Time the participant spent reading the question page, in milliseconds.
Time the participant spent selecting an answer on the answers page, in milliseconds.
Participant's overall percentage of correct answers across regular trials in the session.
Participant's score on the LexTALE English vocabulary test administered before the eye tracking session. Empty where not recorded.
